assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create one production-quality landscape illustration for Arbor, a child development companion's playful game area: the static fallback background for "Mood Mountain". This is a new original raster illustration, no reference image. Output a single full-bleed 3:2 landscape image.
Scene: a welcoming rounded mountain landscape with a gently winding path, soft cloud shapes, little wildflowers, a small still pond and cozy trees. A warm sun and a soft rainy cloud coexist naturally, suggesting all feelings belong without ranking feelings or portraying sadness as failure. An inviting place to explore, not a competition or summit achievement.
Style: contemporary children's graphic novel for roughly ages 5–10, confident clean dark-navy ink outlines, painterly gouache color areas, charming hand-drawn texture, expressive environmental forms, sophisticated editorial finish. Coherent restrained sage/mint, powder blue, warm cream, ochre and small terracotta accents. Clearly illustrated, not photorealistic or 3D plastic. Interesting enough for a child without busy sparkles.
Composition: broad clear central landscape, landmarks in the upper middle 65%; lower 30% is quiet landscape with low detail so the app can overlay white labels. Keep essential landmarks away from the outer 15% on every side for responsive center-cropping into a 4:3 or square card. No tall narrow portrait composition.
Text: none. No letters, numbers, UI, panels, border, logo, watermark, stars earned, badges or rewards. No human, child's face, real child likeness, superhero, mascot, animal character or facial emoji. The family's own generated hero image is a separate app layer; this background should belong to any family.
assets.status: Astra candidate approved; in-product crop/failure checks pending
